title: Etale sum extension preserves flat sheaves and K-flat complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $u:U\to X$ a separated etale morphism of finite type of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and the sheafified sum extension $u_{\Sigma!}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. If $F$ is a flat module sheaf on $U$, then $u_{\Sigma!}F$ is flat on $X$, where flat means that tensoring with the sheaf preserves exact sequences [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. If $P$ is an arbitrary unbounded K-flat cochain complex on $U$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex], then its degreewise sum extension $u_{\Sigma!}P$ is K-flat on $X$. Here K-flat means that its direct-sum total tensor with every acyclic complex is acyclic [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. In particular, if $P$ is K-flat and every $P^n$ is flat, then $u_{\Sigma!}P$ is K-flat with flat terms. There are no boundedness, constructibility, Noetherian, or finiteness hypotheses on the coefficient ring.
